targetText:
Diminution of the variable capital may therefore be compensated
by a proportionate rise in the degree of exploitation of labour-power,
or the decrease in the number of the labourers employed by a proportionate
extension of the working day.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Rate and Mass of Surplus-Value: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText:
It was not less active in the old-fashioned bakeries
than in the modern cotton factories.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
